source.publication: 2025 Form MO-1040, Form MO-A and Form MO-1040 Instructions (Missouri Department of Revenue); 2025 Missouri Income Tax Reference Guide (Form 4711)
source.section: Form MO-1040 PDF p2 Lines 1-8 and 14-15, PDF p3 Lines 25-30 (instructions PDF pp6-9); Instructions PDF p8 Line 14 standard deductions; PDF p21 Tax Rate Chart Sections A and B; record base.deductions; Form MO-A PDF p3 Part 3 Section B Lines 1-9; instructions PDF p17; Reference Guide PDF p9; record private_pension_subtraction; Form MO-A PDF p1 Part 1 Line 11; instructions PDF p14 Line 11; record railroad_retirement_exempt

worked: Single, age 60. Railroad retirement (Tier II) is exempt on Part 1 Line 11, without a cap and outside both pension sections, so it is out of Line 6 and of the income test. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 18,000.00 + pensions 36,000.00 = 54,000.00. Federal taxable income = 54,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 38,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 54,000.00. Line 2 additions 0.00. Line 3 total income 54,000.00. Line 4 subtractions: MO-A Part 1 Line 11 railroad retirement benefits 30,000.00; total 30,000.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 54,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 24,000.00. Section B: Line 1 24,000.00; Line 2 0.00; Line 3 24,000.00; Line 4 25,000.00; Line 5 0.00; Line 6Y 6,000.00, Line 7Y 6,000.00; Line 8 6,000.00; Line 9 6,000.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 6,000.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 26 subtotal 24,000.00 - 6,000.00 - 15,750.00 = 2,250.00. Line 29 taxable income 2,250.00. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 937.00 = 18.74; total 18.74 = 18.74. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 19; expected keeps the bands. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 24,000.00 - Line 8 6,000.00 = 18,000.00; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 24,000.00.
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).
